requirements: The player's own P-WARS2.ROM: ASCII's Penguin-kun Wars 2 for the MSX2, 256 KB, the dump identified above
An MSX2 (the game needs one), PLAYNET release 3, over an MSXPi
A memory mapper with at least 19 free 16 KB segments for the game (512 KB)
